goal: Separate fatal system runtime errors from block consensus and policy validity
Stop non-validating routines from taking block validation state out-parameters just to signal errors
Prevent callers from having to untangle valid, invalid, and fatal error results from a single state
reviewability: Review logic now despite merge conflicts; rebase is mechanical
agreement: Concept support for explicit value-based error separation (optout21, hodlinator, l0rinc, arejula27)
Contested objection: caller handling risks conflating failures with invalid blocks and causing splits (purpleKarrot)
Contested objection: using expected over exceptions hurts initial block download performance (purpleKarrot)
Contested objection: may alter miner error handling and validation notification behavior (optout21)
Unaddressed objection: adding kernel FatalError type is out of scope and broadens maintenance (arejula27)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it reshapes error reporting cleanly across the libbitcoinkernel boundary
Removes internal error enumerations from the public C API and C++ wrapper

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it decouples fatal system runtime failures from consensus validity across chainstate functions
